dossier.scp_unleashed.178.title: 3-D Specs
dossier.scp_unleashed.178.caption: SCP-178 at intake, unfolded beside its evidence tag.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-178 is kept folded inside a sealed storage container in a standard security locker. It is never to be worn outside approved testing.
A subject wearing SCP-178 must be observed at all times by at least two personnel who are not wearing it. **Observers are to record what the subject does, not what the subject reports.**
Anyone who has worn SCP-178 is to remain under watch for the rest of the shift.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-178 is a pair of cardboard 3-D glasses of the kind once handed out at cinemas, with a red lens on the left and a blue lens on the right. Nothing about its make is unusual.
A wearer sees the world split into red and blue images, slightly out of step with each other, like an old 3-D film watched without a screen.

After a short time, wearers begin to see SCP-178-1: tall, thin, hunched figures with leathery tan skin and very long arms that end in claws. The elongated head has a ridged vertical slit for a face and two whip-like growths curving back from the crown.

SCP-178-1 can be seen only by the wearer it appeared to, and only through the lenses. Cameras, observers and other wearers detect nothing. It does not interact with anything else. %rIt passes through other people without slowing.%r
More instances appear the longer SCP-178 is worn.

page.title: Addendum 178-1: Test Log
text: Test 178-02: four minutes. Two figures at the edge of a field, watching. No incident.
Test 178-05: nine minutes. Seven figures, some closer. The subject asked to stop.
Test 178-07: the subject struck at a figure with a baton and was hurt soon after by nothing the observers saw.
Test 178-09: the subject ran. He came back winded and unhurt.
Subjects who described the figures in the most detail tended to have the shortest tests.

page.title: Addendum 178-2: Incident and Provenance
text: During an escalating test, D-178-11 tore SCP-178 off in a panic. The observers recorded nothing further. %rThe subject could not say what had been standing behind him.%r
SCP-178 was handed over by the unidentified courier noted in other files.

item.scp_unleashed.scp178_glasses.toolti: Cheap cardboard 3-D glasses. One red lens, one blue.
Worn on the head. The world never quite lines up through them.
Whatever you see through them can see you too.
death.attack.scp_unleashed.scp178_taken: %1$s was taken by something only they could see
%1$s was taken by something only they could see while fighting %2$s
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp178_glasses.1: SCP-178 is a pair of cheap cardboard 3-D glasses with a red lens and a blue lens. Worn on the head, they split the world into red and blue, like an old 3-D film.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp178_glasses.2: Wearers report tall, thin figures with slits for faces that nobody else can see. They seem to belong to the wearer alone. Long wear has been fatal.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp178_glasses.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-178 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger in Foundation dress finds you and hands the glasses over. They fit in a storage container.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp178.status: SCP-178: %s, worn for %s s, %s of up to %s instances present, %s hunting.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp178.no_room: There was no free ground for SCP-178-1 nearby.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp178.summoned: An SCP-178-1 instance appears about %s blocks away. Only you can see it.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp178.exposure: SCP-178 exposure set to %s minute(s). Up to %s instances may now appear.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp178.0: The courier hands the glasses over in person.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp178.1: Never let a wearer test alone.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp178.full: There are already %s SCP-178-1 instances around you.
